data.headline: Technical Director / Director of Engineering | Driving Game Development at Scale | Live Services, Pipelines, and Cross-Discipline Execution
data.about:
Technical leader with 25+ years of experience spanning game development, live operations, and production technology, with the last 18 years focused in the games industry. I specialize in bridging engineering, production, and operations to help teams ship high-quality games efficiently and at scale.

My background sits at the intersection of technology and execution—leading cross-discipline teams, improving development pipelines, and solving the complex coordination challenges that come with modern game development. I’ve worked across live services, tooling, and production environments, helping studios increase velocity, reduce friction, and deliver consistently.

I’m particularly focused on:

* Building and leading high-performing technical teams
* Scaling development pipelines and production workflows
* Driving alignment between engineering, production, and creative
* Supporting live operations and long-term game health
* Delivering predictable, high-quality outcomes in complex environments

I thrive in environments where clarity, execution, and adaptability matter—whether that’s scaling a studio, stabilizing production, or evolving technology to meet the needs of a growing team.

Currently focused on Technical Director / Director-level opportunities where I can have broad impact across teams, technology, and delivery.

Experts enjoy access to early-stage businesses, emerging trends and technology, and an expanded network of exceptional leaders and resources through a top-tier seed-stage firm.

Primary is New York City’s premier early-stage venture firm working alongside founders to build unicorns like Alloy, Alma, Chief, Dandy Electric, Latch, K Health, Stellar Health, Slice, and many more.

Responsible for global end user services, physical data centers, networking, IT infrastructure, (laptops/desktops/VDI/mobile devices/corporate servers), productivity tools, ITSM transformation, and security operations.

- Manage a team of 9 Engineers and managers
- Accountable for supporting 7 offices globally with 650+ employees, SDWAN, Wireless and Zero Trust
- Built Incident and Change Management process
- Planned and executed a move out from Russia to USA, all hardware and data.
- Maintain Zero Trust network, moving away from VPN.

- Re-architected Infrastructure for hybrid on-prem and cloud capacity
- Created Inventory system reducing cost and utilizing unused hardware
- Generated reporting to track annual spend and working with teams to reduce unnecessary licensing costs.

- Manage a team of 40+ Engineers, across 6 disciplines in over 10 locations worldwide.
- Owned and supported 19 countries with 55 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. SDWAN, Wireless across all physical locations.
- Owning IT CI/CD, SCM Perforce & GitHub (Epic and Licensee), Operations, Incident and Change Management, Public and Private Cloud Infrastructure.

I encourage my team to do what is right by the developers we support, by having open communication on tools and technology.

My job was to get out of the way of smart people and help them get unblocked from doing amazing things.

 - Manage a team of engineers in various global locations (America, Mexico, Belarus, Finland, UK and China)
 - Reduced cost of vendor spending by creating open conversation and trust between the 3rd parties and Epic. 
 - Mentor and coach junior to principle engineers across Team Online and IT
 - Developed Team Vision and reduced tech debt across the platform that runs Fortnite and multiple studio applications
 - Worked with vendors and internal procurement team to realign contracts to future Epic needs, along with improving relationships.
 - Created a team that wants to help one another, knowledge share, and treats everyone as an equal. 

I was lucky to have the privilege to lead them.

Responsible for helping teams work on the right things, at the right time, as well as plan for the future.

- Worked with Team Leads in US, EU, CN regions to prioritize Projects and get initiative updates.
- Driving conversations across the organisation and regularly meeting stakeholders.
- Helping support the Lead Infrastructure Engineer with managing vendors and all 3rd parties. (this was from new tools and technology to restructuring previous contracts to meet new needs)
 - Helped hiring for engineering teams across Team Online (TON) and IT

- Build the Live Operations group, for global support
- Design and Develop Incident Management, with post mortem support for major events
- Support multiple projects from esports to SDK development with game and development teams
- Risk Management for Live Operations and Production
- Produce a platform that would integrate all metrics with automated alerting 
- Define and lead an integrated Infrastructure and Operations service strategy and technical roadmap.
- Develop staff
- Work with key shareholders to formulate a comprehensive technology plan that is consistent with the overall business objectives and budgetary considerations.

Responsible for:

 - Manage a group of 4 US based Managers, for Operations, with dotted lines from 2 further managers in Europe. Each manager has 5-10 direct reports, who in turn work 4x10hr shifts (some ~30 staff globally).
 - Created a Monitoring Working Group to help build momentum and consensus for how we do monitoring, from rule sets to software defined solutions.
 - Helped architect and roll out a re-organisation of resources, enabling key skill sets and helping to define core competencies for Operations to succeed.
 - Lead Incident, Problem and Change Management.
 - Reporting and analytics for day to day, week to week activity across groups.
 - Project Manager for all new projects, from scope to ensuring correct testing and completion signoff
 - Lead Incident Manager, for BlizzCon events.

- Responsible for Incident Investigation and Problem Management 
- Operational Readiness for both Software to External Games, Software (Internal) for Development and Service teams, as well as Infrastructure Readiness for new Data Center Build outs
- Live Title / Launch Support covering both US and APAC regions, travelling to stakeholder sites.
- Manage, Mentor and Advise MCC Monitoring team. Developing new front end systems for support teams.
- Mission Control Center (MCC) - Management. Building a new support team for Tier 1 and 2 Support operations. Assisted from concept to rollout, from interviewing to full time training. This was originally 30 people in Mexico (NOC and Unix-FLS), and then hiring a team of 20 people in Austin, Texas.
- Escalation for SSL and DDOS Mitigation. Worked with Network Engineering, in a strike-team environment, enabling engineers to 'fault fix' and battle incoming attacks, whilst making notes on attack patterns to communicate to Executive Level staff, keeping them appraised of the situations.
- Process Improvement for the Network Operations Center, building a NOC'epedia and training team members with an aim to improve reaction times and ensure our Players can access the games when they want to play!
- Operational Readiness Manager for numerous projects, from game development to building/deploying new data centers (USA and Europe primarily)
- The 'gets it done' specialist. Never a task too big or too small.

Worked as Senior Lead on Star Wars the Old Republic, for Bioware, and later EA on there Digital Platform.
 - Live Operations - Supporting the millions of customers we had, ensuring a 99.999% up time,  managing and coaching a group of engineers to have a 'Players First' mentality.
 - NOC L1 and L2. Hiring over 12 Engineers in Ireland, and 6 in the USA, for supporting Windows, Unix, Database and Data Centers (5 at peak) covering 24x7. This was primarily NetApp Storage and HP Blade technology.
 - Streamlining all procedures - Since this was early development (Alpha) I fostered a program to knowledge share between Development and Operations. This enabled a huge knowledge transfer to occur, which the team actioned and recorded on a Runbook/Knowledgebase, as we approached launch.
 - DevOps
 - L3 Support
 - Tools and Tech
    - Development of in-house tools, as well as Zabbix, Opswise, and Splunk
